stem: A child is about to receive high-dose head and neck radiation, a treatment that commonly causes oral mucositis. Which statement best explains the role of oral hygiene in this child's care?

options.text: Oral hygiene should be minimized because it aggravates mucositis.
Good oral hygiene lowers oral microbial load, which may reduce the host inflammatory response and the severity of mucositis.
Oral hygiene has no bearing on the severity of mucositis.
Good oral hygiene raises microbial load and so increases the host inflammatory response.
